Several other exotic pets were found in the apartment and seized by police, including an alligator named Al in another bedroom. Be Human Like a Tiger A tiger doesn't roar to prove strength. It moves in silence. It waits, watches, and chooses its moment. Not every battle is worth energy. A tiger walks alone-not because it's lonely, but because it trusts itself. Scars don't make it weaker; they remind it that it survived. When a tiger strikes, it commits fully. No hesitation. No doubt. It doesn't chase approval. The jungle already knows what it is. Life lesson: Move with purpose. Speak less, observe more. Protect your energy. Trust your power.
